description: Source code for a Linux kernel module implementing a Button Hotplug driver, handling input events for buttons and generating uevents.

methods.name: button_hotplug_event
methods.description: Handles input events from buttons, creates corresponding uevents.

methods.name: button_hotplug_create_event
methods.description: Creates and schedules a button event.

methods.name: button_hotplug_fill_event
methods.description: Fills event data with environment variables.

methods.name: button_get_index
methods.description: Returns index of button code in button_map.

methods.name: button_hotplug_init
methods.description: Initializes the driver, registers input handler.

methods.name: button_hotplug_exit
methods.description: Cleans up the driver, unregisters input handler.
